summary: parse_battles reads ListPvPBattles2 into BattleRecord values against the pss1/pss5 captures. Absent fields stay None; trophy counts of "0" are read as unreported, a defender's trophy change and opponent hull level are not derivable from the capture. A malformed battle list is unobserved (None).  run_pvp_battle evidence uses a battle list re-read after the call and only a battle id lastBattleId took during the call. A matching attack record supports the outcome only when it is decided and its trophy change agrees in sign with the observed one; a defense record never does. Building the evidence never raises after a battle: a failure journals it unsupported. Battle reports take opponent cohorts from a matching attack record. listPvPBattles2 moves to mocked-test. Built by a subagent in an isolated worktree; an independent verifier subagent found 7 issues (stale battle id, undecided or disagreeing records, evidence crash after a battle, malformed lists, a vacuous test, winner vs trophy sign), all fixed with regression tests; re-validated by the parent agent.

contract_status_changes.contract: Parse ListPvPBattles2 into typed battle records and use them for verification and cohorts
contract_status_changes.before: battle outcomes verified only from trophy change plus finalise; cohorts from journal evidence only
contract_status_changes.after: typed battle records; a matching attack record from this call supports the outcome; defense records never do
proof: make syntax-check, make test, scripts/ci.py lint and git diff --check pass on current main
verifier findings fixed; regression tests fail on the old code

residual_risks: No live path re-reads the battle list after a battle yet; a record alone cannot upgrade an outcome without runner.py changes (recorded in SPEC-03).
